claim_boundary: V19AY validates a measurement likelihood; it does not score an ambiguous candidate or change a positional association.
The five anchors are the unchanged internal validation set and are not a newly untouched holdout.
Profiling brightness deliberately removes aperture normalization, so this test can validate color-shape discrimination but cannot estimate stellar luminosity or mass.
A pass authorizes a separately frozen full-posterior application that preserves null and ambiguous states; it does not authorize a hard counterpart, mass, current, lensing, halo or gravity claim.
